name: Bahia
title: LGBTQ rights in Bahia
extract: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ) rights in Bahia have been the subject of advances over the last few decades, driven by social movements, public policies and specific legislation. The Brazilian state is often cited as a pioneer in implementing initiatives aimed at promoting citizenship and protecting the rights of the community, in addition to acting to combat discrimination and violence.
